notes:
SUMMARY: Enterprise evaluation focused on Dedicated reserved GPU pools across regions/AZs. Primary ask: predictable throughput guarantees for customer-facing chat and background embedding pipelines, with strict latency SLOs for support chat (p95 <= 120ms token-gen on 8k context).

KEY REQUIREMENTS / QUANT: 
- Workloads: real-time support chat (peak load ~2k concurrent chats, 120 reqs/s sustained), nightly embedding ingest pipeline (~5M docs/month), reranking for search (latency sensitive).
- Throughput target: ability to sustain 3k token/sec aggregate across hosted endpoints during peak across regions.
- Latency SLOs: p50 token latency target 30-40ms, p95 token latency <=120ms; end-to-end response SLO for chat 300ms for short prompts.
- Reservation ask: initial reserved pool plan: 24 A100-equivalent GPUs split 14/10 across us-east-1/us-west-2 with 20% failover headroom (i.e., ability to burst additional capacity between regions), auto-failover policy preferred.
- Failover model: active-active with weighted routing by region; synchronous KV cache replication NOT required but prefix cache warmup plan needed.
- Fallbacks: lower-precision quantized variants for non-critical reranking to keep latency during partial failure.

SLA / CONTRACT FABRIC: 
- They require a written throughput guarantee tied to reserved pool (tokens/sec per GPU) and a credits-based remedy for missed SLOs (credits up to 10% of monthly fee for repeated misses).
- Security: VPC peering + private endpoints, KMS integration, audit logs to their SIEM. Data residency: master copies must remain in NA regions.

POC NOTES & OBSERVATIONS: 
- POC (9/02–9/09) ran with 8 reserved GPUs (mixed p4/p3) — observed p95 token latency ~145ms under synthetic spikes; need kernel tuning and batch sizing advice from Optimize team.
- Bottleneck analysis: network egress and cross-AZ NVLink emulation caused uneven latency; suggested placement groups and AZ-aware scheduling.
- Cache behavior: KV cache warmup on failover caused 8–12s cold-start tail in early tests; SE recommended prefix caching and pre-warming during failover window.
- Cost sensitivity: CFO flagged dedicated spend; wants clear amortized token cost vs. burst-on-demand model (hybrid).

- "We cannot have unpredictable tails during support spikes — any partial outage must degrade gracefully to lower-fidelity models," — Head of Platform.
- Legal: "Need explicit clause for NA-only residency and audit access every quarter."
